messages:
Maria G.: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact remediation plan for rollout/flagging improvements after the DB incident. Focus: rollback scenarios, flag scoping, auto-rollback modes, and short run monitoring runbook. Who can pick owners?
Jordan K.: I can own the rollback scenarios matrix. Will draft a table by EOD Tue. Suggest fields: trigger, signal, rollback action, estimated impact, test plan.
Leo N.: I'll take flag scoping templates. Will include percent scopes, cohort selectors, region excludes, and a 'blast_radius' tag. ETA Wed.
Sasha P.: Need someone to enumerate auto-rollback failure modes (dependency timeouts, circuit opens, transient spikes). I can prototype the fallback flow and hysteresis.
deploy-bot: Deployment alert — v2.14 auto-rollback triggered at 2025-03-04T09:12Z due to error-rate>5% :warning:
Maria G.: Linking the postmortem: <https://postmortem/redwood/pm-2025-03-03> — includes logs and traces.
Jordan K.: Adding a tracker board: https://boards/rems/rollbacks — plan to create three priority lanes: P0 (hotfix/rollback), P1 (config tweak), P2 (postmortem followups).
Leo N.: Question: should auto-rollback thresholds be standardized? We had flapping before when transient SIGs hit thresholds.
Sasha P.: Proposal: two-tier thresholds — soft alert (3% errors for 5m) -> sampling/quarantine; hard (5% for 2m) -> auto-rollback. Add a 10m hysteresis window to prevent thrash.
Maria G.: Also require 'blast_radius' tokens on flags (data-plane vs control-plane separation). Owner: @Leo N. Timeline: prototype in 1 sprint. Test owner: @Nina R. for perf sims.
Nina R.: I'll run traffic sims once templates are ready. Need a small harness: 10k req/min for 30m, plus DB connection metrics. ETA Fri.
Jordan K.: I'll update the runbook with playbook steps, escalation contacts, and a fallback-variant policy (e.g., serve smaller model or degrade noncritical features).
Maria G.: Action summary — Jordan: rollback matrix (EOD Tue); Leo: flag templates + blast_radius tokens (Wed); Sasha: auto-rollback modes & prototype (Fri); Nina: sims (Fri); Jordan: runbook edits (Thu). Sync Thu 10:00am in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Pattern detector: recurring incident signature detected — recent rollouts triggered DB connection exhaustion in eu-west. Tagging pattern 'db-conn-spike-euw'.
Maria G.: Good catch. Add remediation item: rate-limit backpressure + connection-pool safeguards for EUW. Suggest owner: @Dan H.
Dan H.: I can take that and coordinate with infra. Will propose connection-pool caps and demand shaper config by next Wed.
Maria G.: Thanks — I'll convert this thread into a short GH issue with owners, due dates, and links to the postmortem and board. If anyone wants to swap tasks, flag here before EOD.
